Title: Sea Glass Shallows Tray
Body (HTML):
A tray that looks like a wave caught mid-ripple. Clear aqua resin crinkles and folds across the whole surface like sunlight on shallow water, and when the light hits it just right, a soft pearly shimmer shows in every fold.

The handles were poured separately and hold little treasures from the shore: tiny starfish, seashells, a piece of green sea glass, pearls and soft green moss, so it's like carrying a strip of beach in each hand. The tray itself was poured freehand in two coats rather than in a mould, so every crinkle and edge is one of a kind.

Lovely on a coffee table, dresser or bathroom counter for candles in their own glass, perfume bottles or keepsakes. This is a decorative piece, not for food.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!
